author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA+DAQB (Anscombe) kd=22 delta=0.12 k=50
abstract: MPB-GraphFWPCA with Anscombe VST (α_g=0.5), PCA50, per-PC ridge shrinkage (λ=0.605, γ_max=0.74). DAQB graph with kd=22, delta=0.12, k=50, cosine, cap=2.0. Provides QC embedding and batch-corrected graph.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from mpb_graphfwpca_anscombe import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca_anscombe as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        alpha_emb=0.5, n_pcs_emb=60, emb_n_neighbors=15,
        alpha_g=0.5, n_pcs_graph=50,
        l2=1e-3, gamma_max=0.74, lam_override=0.605,
        k_total=50, kdensity=22, delta=0.12,
        metric='cosine', cap=2.0, rng_seed=0, adata=adata
    )
